tip.label: What is this?
tip.tier: The tier sets how much approval a payment needs: 0 and 1 are automatic, 2 needs one tap, 3 needs an OTP code and a 10-minute wait.
tip.fraud: The risk score comes from fixed rules in code, not from the AI. A higher score means more checks failed.
tip.cooling: After you confirm a Tier 3 action there is a 10-minute wait before money can move. You can cancel during it.
tip.kyb: KYB badges show which business checks (registration, address, history) the supplier has passed.
